name: pace: about how long the voice takes to say a sentence, in ms, as the build is set, beside how long each recorded sentence took (the time in its name). Digits, commas and codes in capitals are slow: a sentence of 96 letters that names "RNR01", "GPA" and "2.0" took 8.2 s. The estimate was a median 0.23 s from the true time on 2,000 recorded lines, and it is short on the code's sentence, which is why that one is not seen as slow
